The *Āsavavippayuttasāsavaduka* (Patthana 8.19) is a section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka in the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The text analyzes the conditional relations (paccaya) pertaining to the dyad (*duka*) of phenomena that are dissociated from mental defilements or pollutants (*āsava-vippayutta*) while still remaining subject to them (*sāsava*) [SuttaCentral].

Its most substantial matches occur with other *Paṭṭhāna* sections treating the *āsava* group (*āsavagocchaka*) and related matrix dyads, most notably *Āsavagocchaka* (Patthana 2.3; 22 matches), *Kusalattika, Āsavaparāmāsagocchaka* (Patthana 4.4; 12 matches), and *Āsavagocchaka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 3.4; 10 matches) [DharmaNexus]. Neither SuttaCentral nor DharmaNexus records any cross-language parallels or alignments meeting the significance threshold in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan corpora [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. The references returned from secondary literature do not address this specific *Paṭṭhāna* text directly, discussing the dyad solely as it appears within the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī*.
